quantity: duplicate reagents for one triple inside one cohort
reason: Danenberg ships two HER2 antibody clones - HER2 (3B5) and HER2 (D8F12) - and both resolve to HGNC:3430. No earlier cohort produced a duplicate so nothing handled it. All three readers called drop_duplicates('triple') and silently kept whichever clone came first in registry order
note: AVERAGE the duplicate columns. Averaging uses both channels the dataset shipped and cancels clone-specific noise; keeping one discards a real measurement, the same mistake as feeding a zero for a marker nobody looked at. The 'higher dynamic range' alternative from files/03 3.3 is REJECTED: it needs the dynamic range before the value table exists, and it is a data-dependent choice made after seeing the data. Implemented once in pipeline2/panel_util.py and used by s1_values, s2_tokens and s1b_labels. Every duplicate is printed when used

quantity: SMA resolves to ACTA2 (HGNC:130) not SMN1 (HGNC:11117)
reason: D-55. Bare SMA reached SMN1 - spinal muscular atrophy - through an HGNC PREVIOUS symbol. It is an unambiguous single hit so 'spellings must agree' and the review queue never fired. Hits KEREN as well as Danenberg, which is how the bogus slot entered the frozen 99
note: confirmed externally by the shipped antibody clone: AbPanel.csv gives clone 1A4, the classic anti-alpha-smooth-muscle-actin. Removing HGNC:11117 also takes ACTA2 from 2 cohorts to 4

quantity: FSP1 resolves to S100A4 (HGNC:10494) not AIFM2
reason: D-55. FSP1 is fibroblast-specific protein 1 = S100A4; it resolved to AIFM2 via UniProt
note: S100A4 is on the fibroblast-specific marker list files/02 2.2 says the roster lacks. AbPanel clone is 'Polyclonal FSP1'

quantity: CD31-vWF resolves to PECAM1 (HGNC:8823) not VWF
reason: D-55. Resolved to VWF alone, so Danenberg sat on its own triple and D-54 measured Endothelial landing in a stromal cluster
note: files/03 3.3 predicted a COMPLEX. REJECTED: a COMPLEX: triple would not merge with the six cohorts already on HGNC:8823, so Danenberg would stay isolated and the failure would persist. Confirmed externally by the shipped clone JC70A, the classic anti-CD31. PECAM1 now covers all 7 cohorts

quantity: the four previously unresolved Danenberg channels
reason: CK5, CK8-18, ER and c-Caspase3 had no triple and were being dropped. ER is oestrogen receptor on a breast cohort - dropping it is a real loss
note: CK5 -> KRT5 (clone EP1601Y, single gene). CK8-18 -> COMPLEX KRT8_18 (clone C51 is a dual keratin 8/18 reagent). c-Caspase3 -> COMPLEX CC3_CPARP because the two shipped panel files DISAGREE (markerStackOrder says c-Caspase3c-PARP, AbPanel says Cleaved Caspase3) and the rule is never guess. ER -> ESR1 on three lines of evidence: six published phenotypes are defined by ER level covering 319841 cells, function_order 5 groups it with the breast tumour markers, and AbPanel is loose elsewhere - it calls the CD45RO channel plain CD45 despite clone 2B11. AbPanel's Ho165 row lists the anti-rabbit SECONDARY reagent, not the target
